Woman Rescued Alive After 10 Days Trapped Under Nepal Landslide Debris

A 60-year-old woman was rescued alive in Nepal after being trapped under landslide debris for 10 days. The rescue occurred after hopes had diminished, with the woman found breathing amidst the rubble. The incident highlights a survival against the odds narrative.
